tagline: Authentic Savory Umami in Fine Powder
overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried soya sauce powder from selected fermented soybeans through a controlled drying process. This free-flowing powder captures the savory umami flavor profile of traditional liquid soy sauce. With moisture levels maintained below five percent and an 80 to 100 mesh size, it ensures instant solubility and smooth mixing into dry mixes and food formulations.

As an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter based in India, we deliver consistent quality for international supply chains. Our production follows a thorough six-step method from sourcing to dispatch. We support B2B clients with OEM services, private labeling, custom mesh adjustments, and comprehensive export documentation, offering scalable volumes starting from a five-kilogram minimum order quantity.
highlights: Free-flowing spray dried powder with 80-100 mesh fineness
Moisture content maintained below 5 percent to prevent caking
Savory umami flavor profile derived from fermented soybeans
Rapid solubility in dry seasonings and liquid bases
Shelf life of 18 to 24 months under standard storage
HS Code 2103.90 with complete batch traceability

faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request for quality assessment and laboratory recipe development.

faqs.q: What export support is provided for international shipments?

faqs.a: The powder has an 18 to 24 month shelf life when stored in a cool, dry place protected from moisture and sunlight.
